Impression: recurrent neurotoxicity after a documented full recovery on 30 Mar.

derivation.onset: Onset (6.2, 6.5, 7.7): first Grade >=1 observation is ICE 8/10 on 2035-03-27 (Day +4), equal to the record. Under 6.5 all findings after one infusion form one episode, so the onset is the first one, 7.7.
derivation.max_grade: Max grade (6.5, A2, A5, 7.7): the highest per-assessment grade across the window is Grade 2 (ICE 5/10, awakens to voice on Day +13, after a documented full resolution on Day +7). Equals the record, so 7.7.

ambiguity_notes: Full resolution (ICE 10/10 on 30 Mar) followed by recurrence triggers the 'recurrence' flag (6.5); the episode is not split automatically (A5). If the episodes were split, the first episode's maximum would be Grade 1, not 2, and the recorded Grade 2 would come from the second; onset would still match the first episode. This is a clinician question about A5, not a second reading under 7.5. Headache and tremor are excluded symptoms (4.2). Tocilizumab and dexamethasone are treatment (A35).
